questions.question: Pointing to a woman, a boy, Rohan, says, “Her father is my father’s father, and she is not my mother.” What is she to Rohan?
questions.explanation: She is a daughter of Rohan’s paternal grandfather, hence his father’s sister.

questions.question: Kavya is the daughter of Ramesh’s daughter. Ramesh is a man. Which pair correctly names the relationship in both directions?
questions.explanation: The middle person is Ramesh’s daughter, so Kavya is his granddaughter through her mother.

questions.question: Code: X + Y means X is Y’s brother; X - Y means X is Y’s mother; X * Y means X is Y’s husband. In A * B - C + D, how many people are certainly male?
questions.explanation: A is male as husband and C as brother; B is female and D’s gender is unknown.

questions.question: A verbal tree places Dhruv (male) and Gita (female) as parents of sons Hemant and Ishaan. Hemant’s wife Juhi has their daughter Kiara. Which person is Kiara’s father’s brother?
questions.explanation: Kiara’s father is Hemant; Hemant’s brother is Ishaan.

questions.question: Tanya’s daughter is married to Manish. Manish’s mother is Sudha. Relative to Sudha, what is Tanya’s daughter?
questions.explanation: She is the wife of Sudha’s son Manish, so she is Sudha’s daughter-in-law.

questions.question: Code: X @ Y means X is Y’s daughter; X # Y means X is Y’s brother; X $ Y means X is Y’s mother. N is male. Which expression makes N the maternal grandfather of M’s brother P?
questions.explanation: P is M’s brother; M is R’s daughter and R is N’s daughter, making N the father of their mother R.

questions.question: Seven relatives A–G form three generations. A is B’s husband and C is their son. E is F’s mother. D is F’s maternal aunt and C’s wife. G is C’s daughter. E and D are sisters; E’s husband is outside this group. C and D are G’s parents. Who is G’s maternal aunt?
questions.explanation: G’s mother is C’s wife D; D’s sister E is G’s maternal aunt.

questions.question: A and B are siblings of unspecified gender. A is parent of a boy C. B is parent of a girl D. Which relationship is certain?
questions.explanation: Their parents A and B are siblings, so C and D are cousins regardless of the parents’ genders.

questions.question: A man, Yusuf, points to a girl: “Her mother and I have the same mother, but her mother is not my wife.” Through which person is Yusuf related to the girl?
questions.explanation: Yusuf and the girl’s mother share a mother; since Yusuf is male, she is his sister.

questions.question: There are 4 boys and 3 girls in one sibling group. Each child has the same parents. For any one girl, what is the ratio of her brothers to her sisters?
questions.explanation: A girl has 4 brothers and 2 sisters, excluding herself; 4:2 simplifies to 2:1.

questions.question: Let X # Y mean X is Y’s father, X @ Y mean X is Y’s sister, and X % Y mean X is Y’s son. In D % C @ B # A, D is A’s _____.
questions.explanation: A’s father is B; B’s sister is C; C’s son is D.

questions.question: Question: Is A B’s father? I. A is male and B is A’s child. II. B is A’s daughter. Which judgement is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: I alone suffices; II alone does not

options.label: D
options.text: II alone suffices; I alone does not

questions.explanation: I gives a male parent, hence father; II fixes only B’s gender, leaving A’s gender unknown.

questions.question: A man, Bhuvan, is father of Charu. Charu’s husband Devesh has a sister Ekta. Ekta’s son is Feroz. Which of these links is established between Charu and Feroz?

options.label: B
options.text: Charu is Feroz’s mother’s brother’s wife

questions.explanation: Feroz’s mother is Ekta, Ekta’s brother is Devesh, and his wife is Charu.

questions.question: X + Y means X is Y’s son, X - Y means X is Y’s mother, X * Y means X is Y’s brother. Which expression is inconsistent if each person has only one mother and all letters denote distinct people?
questions.explanation: A - B and C - B make distinct A and C both B’s mother, violating the condition.

questions.question: A woman, Pavneet, says of a boy in a school photograph: “His father is my husband’s only brother.” Which description gives the boy’s relationship to Pavneet?
questions.explanation: The boy’s father is Pavneet’s husband’s brother, so the boy is her nephew through that marriage.

questions.question: The verbal tree has married parents A (male) and B (female), their sons C and D, C’s wife E, D’s wife F, and daughters G of C–E and H of D–F. Which statement is false?
questions.explanation: G and H have different sibling fathers, so they are cousins, not sisters.

questions.question: Six people A–F form exactly two married couples and three generations. A is B’s husband. E is C’s sister and A’s daughter. F is D’s daughter and B’s granddaughter. C, a man, is F’s father. Every child’s parents are married. Which member is simultaneously a son, a husband and a father within this family?
questions.explanation: E’s brother C is A–B’s son; F’s parents C and D form the second couple, so C is also husband and father.

questions.question: Rekha’s brother Sanjay is married to Poonam. Poonam’s sister Usha has a daughter, Vidhi. What is Vidhi’s relationship to Sanjay?
questions.explanation: Sanjay → wife Poonam → sister Usha → daughter Vidhi is the precise route.

questions.question: Start at a boy A. Go to his mother B, then B’s father C, then C’s son D, then D’s daughter E. What is E’s generation relative to A?
questions.explanation: Two parent steps up and two child steps down cancel: +1 +1 -1 -1 = 0.

questions.question: A girl has twice as many brothers as sisters. Her brother has the same number of brothers and sisters. How many children share these parents?
questions.explanation: With b boys and g girls, b = 2(g - 1) and b - 1 = g; hence g = 3, b = 4, total 7.

questions.question: In this code X : Y means X is Y’s mother and X ; Y means X is Y’s father. Read A : B ; C : D. Which ordered pair lists D’s mother and maternal grandfather?
questions.explanation: C is D’s mother; C’s father B is D’s maternal grandfather.

questions.question: Code: X @ Y means X is Y’s husband; X + Y means X is Y’s father; X - Y means X is Y’s sister. Which expression proves T’s wife is the sister of R’s father?
questions.explanation: T’s wife is U; U is V’s sister and V is R’s father, giving T @ U - V + R.

questions.question: I. M is N’s wife. II. N is P’s father. Claim: M is certainly P’s biological mother. No rule about remarriage or children of earlier marriages is supplied. Which assessment is logically sound?

options.label: A
options.text: The claim follows from I alone

options.label: B
options.text: The claim needs an additional parenthood fact

options.label: D
options.text: The claim follows from II alone

questions.explanation: A father’s current wife need not be his child’s biological mother; explicit maternity is required here.

questions.question: Nirmal’s father and Sohan’s mother are brother and sister. Both Nirmal and Sohan are men. Which statement describes Nirmal from Sohan’s side?
questions.explanation: Sohan’s mother’s brother is Nirmal’s father; Nirmal is therefore Sohan’s maternal-uncle’s son.

questions.question: A man, Ashok, introduces a woman: “Her only son’s wife is my wife’s only sister.” Ashok’s wife and her sister share the same parents. What is the woman’s son to Ashok?
questions.explanation: The woman’s son is married to Ashok’s wife’s sister, making the two men co-brothers-in-law.
